standard_prerequisites.use: Computes H^0(U, tau_{>= -r+1}E) from the cohomology sheaves.

core_obligations: Since U is covered by r affine opens, H^j(U, F) = 0 for j >= r and any quasi-coherent F.
Replace E by tau_{>= -r+1}E using the K-injective comparison; the hypothesis H^i(E)|_U = 0 for i = -r+1,...,0 kills all cohomology sheaves of the truncation on U.
Run the spectral sequence H^j(U, H^i(tau)) => H^{i+j}(U, tau) to conclude H^0(U, E) = 0; hence s|_U = 0.
View s as a morphism O_X -> E in D(O_X); by the carded representation proposition the composition I_e -> O_X -> E is zero for some e.
The distinguished triangle I_e -> O_X -> K_e -> I_e[1] produces K_e -> E with s factoring as O_X -> K_e -> E.
proof_roadmap: Vanishing on r affines; truncation replacement; spectral-sequence vanishing; representation proposition; triangle finish.
difficulty_reason: A truncation-and-spectral-sequence reduction into the carded representation proposition; each step is explicit.
